The threshold function is continuous and strictly decreasing, so the scalar root is unique. Purely singular, atomic-evaluation, and nonatomic-evaluation boundary cases agree with the formulas.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for the full dual of a recent, explicitly studied lattice renorming rather than a parameter tweak: it gives every signed measure an exact scalar threshold, gives necessary and sufficient norm-attainment conditions, and reveals an entire closed singular band whose dual geometry stays exactly total variation while every nonzero member fails norm attainment. The latter extends the focal phenomenon from lattice homomorphisms to a large linear family and yields sharp distance information for evaluations in the nonatomic case.
